'''Eleyan al'Landerin''' was an ancient [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]].{{Ref|{{twotc}}, Eleyan al'Landerin}}

== History ==
There is a statue of her and her Warders in the southwestern side of [[Tar Valon]], in the same place she sacrificed herself with her [[Warder]]s to stop and repel [[Artur Hawkwing]]'s army at the beginning of the nineteen-year-long siege to the city.

Her name indicates that she was from the [[Two Rivers]] region of [[Farashelle]].
== Background ==
The name of this character comes from the name of a Tarvalon.net member.<ref>[http://library.tarvalon.net/index.php?title=Eleyan_Teyal_Al'Landerin  User Profile on TarValon.net]</ref>

When [[Siuan Sanche|Siuan]] asks [[Shemerin]] where could they find the Watergate, she replies: 

''"On the southwest side of the city, Aes Sedai. About five minutes' walk eastward from where the ancient statues of Eleyan al'Landerin and her Warders stand."''{{Ref/book|12|26}}
